name: Nyet! Contract Veto
summary: Three players play 6 deals of 5 tricks: in each deal the Pair veto trump colours, the Lone names trump, the first leader and an exact trick bid, and every trick scores 1 point for whoever wins it.

player.meaning: Total points: 1 per trick won plus contract scoring.
Cards held this deal, written as colour letter plus number (for example R5, B1, G3, Y2). Only the owner sees it.
True for the seat that is the Lone this deal. The other two seats are the Pair.
The colour this Pair member banned this deal. It is announced after both bans are in.
The card this seat played to the current trick, face up.
Strength of played_card in the current trick: 10 plus its number if it is trump, its number if it is the led colour, otherwise 0.

game.meaning: The 5 undealt cards of the current deal, face down and seen by nobody.
Current deal number, 1 to 6. It becomes 7 when the game is over.
Round within the deal: 1 is the setup round, 2 to 6 are the 5 trick rounds.
Seat of the Lone this deal: ((deal - 1) mod 3) + 1.
Colours not banned by either Pair member this deal.
The trump colour named by the Lone this deal.
The exact number of tricks the Lone promised to win this deal, 0 to 5.
Seat that leads the current trick.
Colour of the card led to the current trick.
Seat that won the most recent trick.
Tricks the Lone has won this deal.

setup: Seats are 1, 2 and 3. Clockwise order is 1 to 2, 2 to 3, and 3 to 1.
The deck list holds the 20 cards R1 to R5, B1 to B5, G1 to G5 and Y1 to Y5.
deal is set to 1, round_in_deal to 1 and round_number to 1.

round.effect: When round_in_deal == 1 (setup round): every card in widow and in any hand is returned to deck. lone_seat = ((deal - 1) mod 3) + 1. is_lone is set true for the seat equal to lone_seat and false for the others. Each player's ban is set to empty, unbanned is reset to all four colours, trump to empty, bid to 0 and lone_tricks to 0. The Lone and the Pair are announced to everyone.

When round_in_deal == 1: shuffle by drawing at random. Each player gets 5 random cards, each moved from deck into that player's hand. The remaining 5 cards of deck are moved into widow, which stays hidden from everyone.
When round_in_deal == 1: each player is sent their own hand, plus lone_seat and the scores.
When round_in_deal == 1: all three write at the same time, and the messages are then broadcast {"to": "all", "text": "Seat {seat} says: {value}"}. No state changes and nothing is binding.

round.answer: one of: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow
round.effect: When round_in_deal == 1: each Pair member's ban is set to the chosen colour, chosen at the same time. Both banned colours are removed from unbanned, leaving 3 colours if the two bans match and 2 if they differ. Both bans and unbanned are announced.

round.answer: one combined choice of trump (a colour in unbanned), first leader (seat 1, 2 or 3) and bid (a whole number 0 to 5), offered as items such as 'trump Red, leader seat 2, bid 3'
round.effect: When round_in_deal == 1: trump, leader and bid are set from the choice and announced.
When round_in_deal >= 2 (trick round): each played_card is set to empty, each card_strength to 0, and led_colour to empty.

round.who: each player in turn, clockwise starting at leader
round.answer: one card from the player's own hand; after the lead, only cards of led_colour if the player holds any
round.effect: When round_in_deal >= 2: the card is removed from that player's hand and set as their played_card, shown face up. For the leader, led_colour is set to the card's colour. Each player hears the earlier plays.

When round_in_deal >= 2: card_strength = 10 + number if the card's colour == trump; = number if its colour == led_colour and is not trump; otherwise 0. trick_winner is the seat with the highest card_strength. That seat's score += 1. If trick_winner == lone_seat, lone_tricks += 1. leader = trick_winner. The winner, all scores and lone_tricks are announced.

When round_in_deal == 6 (after the 5th trick), with T = lone_tricks and B = bid: if |T - B| == 0, the Lone's score += 6; if |T - B| == 1, the Lone's score += 2 and each Pair member's score += 1; if |T - B| >= 2, each Pair member's score += 3. The result is announced.
round_number += 1. If round_in_deal == 6, then deal += 1 and round_in_deal = 1; otherwise round_in_deal += 1.
The game ends if deal > 6 (all 36 rounds played); otherwise it continues.

ending.decided_by: Each player's standing is their total score after 6 deals (36 rounds). The highest total wins, and players level at the top share the result.

rules.text: When the game starts, every player's score is 0 and the deck holds 20 cards: Red, Blue, Green and Yellow, each numbered 1 to 5.
When a deal begins (round_in_deal 1), each of the 3 players receives exactly 5 random cards from the deck into their hand, and the remaining 5 cards go into the widow, which nobody sees.
When a deal begins, all cards from the previous deal's hands and widow are first returned to the deck, so 20 cards are dealt.
When the deal is 1 or 4 the Lone is seat 1; when it is 2 or 5 the Lone is seat 2; when it is 3 or 6 the Lone is seat 3; the other two seats are the Pair, and this is announced.
When the setup round's talk step runs, all 3 players submit one short message simultaneously, and all messages are then shown to everyone; no state changes.
When the veto step runs, only the 2 Pair members are asked, simultaneously, and each names one of Red, Blue, Green or Yellow.
When both Pair members ban the same colour, 3 colours remain unbanned; when they ban different colours, 2 remain.
When the Lone makes the contract, trump must be an unbanned colour, the first leader may be seat 1, 2 or 3, and the bid is a whole number from 0 to 5.
When the first trick of a deal is played, the leader is the seat the Lone named; on each later trick, the leader is the previous trick's winner.
When a trick is played, the leader plays first, then the next seat clockwise (1 to 2, 2 to 3, 3 to 1), then the remaining seat.
When a player who is not leading holds a card of the led colour, they must play a card of the led colour; when they hold none, they may play any card in their hand.
When a card is played, it is removed from the player's hand and shown face up to everyone.
When at least one trump is played in a trick, the player of the highest-numbered trump wins it; otherwise the player of the highest-numbered card of the led colour wins it.
When a trick is won, the winner's score increases by 1, whether they are the Lone or a Pair member.
When the Lone wins a trick, lone_tricks increases by 1; the winner, the scores and lone_tricks are announced after every trick.
When the 5th trick of a deal ends and the Lone's tricks equal the bid, the Lone gains 6 and the Pair gain nothing.
When the 5th trick of a deal ends and the Lone's tricks differ from the bid by exactly 1, the Lone gains 2 and each Pair member gains 1.
When the 5th trick of a deal ends and the Lone's tricks differ from the bid by 2 or more, each Pair member gains 3 and the Lone gains nothing.
When deal 6 has been scored (after round 36), the game ends and the player with the highest score wins; players level at the top share it.

offers.question: Talk (setup round)
offers.options: Any seat: one short free-text message.

offers.question: Veto (setup round)
offers.options: Each Pair seat: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow. The Lone is not asked.

offers.question: Contract (setup round)
offers.options: Every combination of trump (each colour in unbanned, 2 or 3 of them), leader (seat 1, seat 2, seat 3) and bid (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5): 36 options when 2 colours remain unbanned and 54 when 3 remain.

offers.question: Play a card (trick round)
offers.who: each seat in turn, clockwise from leader
offers.options: Leader: any card in their hand. A later seat holding at least one card of led_colour: only those cards. A later seat holding no card of led_colour: any card in their hand.

choices.why: The designer fixed 3. The rules depend on 3 seats: a 1-versus-2 Lone/Pair split, 5 cards each plus a 5-card widow from 20 cards, and a fixed clockwise order. Any other count breaks the deal and the rotation. Strategy: the Lone bids a count they can hit exactly, using trump and the first leader to steer. The Pair try to push the Lone 2 or more tricks off the bid, either by taking tricks or by feeding the Lone extra ones, while still collecting 1 point per trick.

choices.what: Talk kept as one simultaneous poll broadcast to all
choices.why: The source requires it. It earns its place because the Pair benefit from coordinating vetoes (matching bans leave 3 colours, different bans leave 2), while the Lone can mislead and each Pair member is also a rival for the overall win.

choices.what: The contract is offered as one combined choice list
choices.why: The rules call it one decision of three parts. Listing every valid trump, leader and bid combination keeps it to one choice and enforces that trump is unbanned.

choices.what: Cards are written as colour letter plus number (R1..Y5), and trick strength is computed as 10 plus number for trump, number for the led colour, 0 otherwise
choices.why: This lets the trick winner be found by arithmetic. Every card is distinct, so no ties are possible, matching the rules.

choices.what: Each widow is never revealed, not even at the end
choices.why: The widow is redealt every deal and plays no role in scoring. The rules only say it is unseen during play, so it stays hidden.

simplifications.what: A tie for the highest total is shared as a win rather than declared a draw
simplifications.why: The engine ranks by one expression and players level at the top share the win. This is the engine's form of the source's draw.

simplifications.what: Setup-round and trick-round steps live in one flat round, each gated by a when-condition on round_in_deal
simplifications.why: The engine repeats one step list. Per-step arithmetic conditions select the setup or trick steps without choosing whole blocks.
